items.title: Exercise 1.7: extend compact PI to the original gradient-pair closure

source.anchor: §2.1.1, printed 48–49/PDF 60–61 compact inequalities and density discussion; Exercise 1.7, printed 43/PDF 55
source.attribution: Sinho Chewi, Log-Concave Sampling. Original ASTIS explicit graph-closure bridge for the omitted Euclidean density step; not a printed standalone theorem.

items.statement: On a finite-dimensional complete real Hilbert space E with its Borel structure, let μ be a probability measure and C>0 a fixed real. Suppose the homogeneous function LSI with coefficient 2C holds for every compact smooth real test. Let G be the scalar/vector L² pairs represented almost everywhere by a compact smooth g and its genuine gradient. Every (u,H) in the joint L² norm closure of G then satisfies Varμ(u) ≤ C ‖H‖²₂. This is a pairwise inequality and does not assert a single-valued gradient for arbitrary μ.
assumptions: The original hypothesis is compact smooth LSI, Entμ(v²) ≤ 2C∫‖∇v‖² dμ for all compact smooth v, with homogeneous entropy ∫q log q−(∫q) log(∫q) on μ.
The two L² classes use the same probability measure. Every pair in the starting set has a common actual smooth compact representative and its true gradient; both equalities are a.e. on μ.
Closure is joint norm closure, not scalar-only density. No closability assumption is supplied. Real variance here is the genuine centered second moment of an L² class.

formulae.label: Joint graph closure
formulae.tex: G=\{([g],[\nabla g]):g\in C_c^\infty(E)\},\qquad (u,H)\in\overline G^{\,L^2\times L^2}\ \Longrightarrow\ \operatorname{Var}_\mu(u)\le C\|H\|_{L^2(\mu;E)}^2.

obligations.label: Pass the same-constant bound to all actual joint L² limits
General reversible-form identification and optimal-constant comparison remain separate

bindings.boundary: Same C on the joint closure of the original compact gradient pairs. No uniqueness/closability on arbitrary μ, generator/core identification for general reversible dynamics, optimal-constant theorem, or numbered-exercise/QA admission.
